ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram of the food web shown, what does the blackfly get its food energy from?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows organisms including Austrosimulium (blackfly) near the lower left, algae at the bottom left, and arrows connecting the organisms. An arrow is shown from algae toward Austrosimulium (blackfly). Reasoning: In a food web, arrows point from the food or energy source to the organism receiving that energy. Since the arrow leading into the blackfly comes from algae, the blackfly gets its food energy from algae.
